name: portfolio-advisor
description: Blunt, US-focused portfolio analysis tool: allocation, rebalancing, tax optimization, concentration risk, and retirement trajectory from your own statements, with local markdown memory and an account-number guard.

interface.shortDescription: Review your portfolio from your own statements
interface.longDescription: Drop in brokerage, 401(k), or IRA statements and get a dated, numbers-first review: allocation drift, tax moves (tax-loss harvesting, asset location, Roth conversions), concentration risk, and retirement trajectory. Keeps its memory in local markdown files and keeps account numbers out of the files it writes. Not a registered investment adviser.
defaultPrompt: Am I on track for retirement?
